offers_products.reason: Sells industrial process fluids, lubricants and specialty chemicals such as HOCUT metalworking fluids to steel, aluminum and automotive manufacturers.

offers_services.reason: Chemists and engineers work on customers' factory floors optimizing processes; chemical management services are offered, but products are larger.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are steel, aluminum, automotive, aircraft and machinery manufacturers; no household buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to steel mills, automotive and aircraft manufacturers and industrial parts makers such as John Deere and Boeing.

recurring_revenue.reason: Process fluids and lubricants are consumables reordered continually by manufacturing plants under ongoing supply relationships.

cyclical_demand.reason: Volumes follow steel, auto and industrial production, which fall in downturns, though fluids are consumables.

big_ticket.reason: Fluids and lubricants are small, frequent consumable purchases for plants.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay mainly for manufactured chemical fluids; technical expertise supports the product.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large steelmakers, automakers, aerospace firms and Deere-type industrial manufacturers.

asset_heavy.reason: Specialty chemical blending needs plants and labs, but it isn't heavy manufacturing like utilities or fleets.

notes: Asset-heavy is a judgment call; the company is a mid-intensity specialty chemical manufacturer.
